scenes.title: One error. A clear next step.
scenes.label: SENTINEL AI · PRODUCT TOUR
scenes.narration: Sentinel A I turns sample application errors into evidence and reviewable fixes. This walkthrough uses simulated data.
scenes.note: A local prototype. Simulated data throughout.

scenes.title: Manager Agent
scenes.label: COORDINATE
scenes.narration: The Manager coordinates every handoff. Visit A I Agents to explore each role and its activity.

scenes.title: Monitoring Agent
scenes.label: DETECT
scenes.narration: Monitoring recognizes supported errors in sample logs. Applications shows sample health and monitoring controls.
scenes.note: Supported sample logs become traceable incidents.

scenes.title: Diagnosis Agent
scenes.label: UNDERSTAND
scenes.narration: Diagnosis explains a likely cause with source evidence. Check the cited file, lines, and revision.
scenes.note: A cited explanation, with uncertainty made clear.

scenes.title: Repair Agent
scenes.label: PROPOSE
scenes.narration: Repair proposes a focused change. Compare the exact diff with the original before deciding.
scenes.note: A proposal is evidence to review, not permission to apply.

scenes.title: Testing Agent
scenes.label: CHECK
scenes.narration: Testing checks that exact candidate. Repair and Testing shows results. Failed or missing checks block approval.
scenes.note: Exact candidate. Recorded checks. Clear outcomes.

scenes.title: Your decision stays separate.
scenes.label: HUMAN CHECKPOINT
scenes.narration: You approve or reject in Approval and Recovery. Applying requires separate confirmation. Verification checks the outcome.

scenes.title: Reporting Agent
scenes.label: RECORD
scenes.narration: Reporting records decisions, tests, and recovery outcomes, including failures and unresolved issues. No success is assumed.
scenes.note: Recorded facts, including what remains unresolved.

scenes.title: Start with what needs attention.
scenes.label: WORKSPACE TOUR · DASHBOARD
scenes.narration: The Dashboard summarizes application health, incident counts, and pending reviews. Open recent incidents to investigate.
scenes.note: Health, open incidents, and pending decisions in one place.

scenes.title: Follow the evidence.
scenes.label: WORKSPACE TOUR · INCIDENTS
scenes.narration: Search and filter in Incidents. Open an issue for its overview, diagnosis, patch, tests, timeline, and report.
scenes.note: Find an issue. Inspect its complete story.

scenes.title: Revisit the outcome.
scenes.label: WORKSPACE TOUR · HISTORY
scenes.narration: Incident History keeps closed examples easy to revisit, including rejected, resolved, and unresolved outcomes.
scenes.note: History includes rejected, resolved, and unresolved examples.

scenes.title: Make the workspace comfortable.
scenes.label: WORKSPACE TOUR · SETTINGS
scenes.narration: Settings controls appearance, motion, and refresh preferences. Documentation explains boundaries and links to features.
scenes.note: Appearance and motion preferences. Help at /docs.

scenes.title: Try the guided experience.
scenes.label: YOUR NEXT STEP
scenes.narration: Start the introduction for orientation, or practice decisions in the interactive demo. No real code is executed.
